content_sections.heading: HIL Job Description
content_sections.text: PROJECT MANAGER Implement projects and activities as per the procedure/ agreement. Compile and develop background material for use in discussions and briefing sessions along with relevant supporting data. Prepare periodic work plans (monthly/ quarterly/ biannually/ annually) and implementation framework. Interact/liaise with implementing agencies associated with the project implementation, relevant government and semi- government organizations/ departments and other industry stakeholders in the context of implementation of projects and activities. Timely preparation and submission of documents, communications & reports pertaining to the project. ASSISTANT PROJECT MANAGER Organize meetings, workshops, and training programs for farmers and other stakeholders. Prepare technical briefs, presentations, etc., for technical assistance and awareness activities, including post event reports/summary of discussions. Compile and develop background material for use in discussions and briefing sessions along with relevant supporting data. Prepare periodic work plans (monthly/ quarterly/ biannually/ annually) and implementation framework. Interact/liaise with implementing agencies associated with the project implementation, relevant government and semi- government organizations/ departments and other industry stakeholders in the context of implementation of projects and activities. Timely preparation and submission of documents, communications & reports pertaining to the project.

content_sections.text: Qualification required: PhD in Life Sciences/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agricultural Engineering/ Agriculture related field/ Biotechnology; Master's Degree (Full time) in Life Sciences/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agricultural Engineering/ Agriculture related field/ Biotechnology with MBA. Experience required: Minimum 10 years of experience in working in any sustainable agriculture project. Age limit: Maximum 55 years. Pay: Upto Rs.16 Lakhs per annum with 03% annual increment. Qualification required: PhD in Life Sciences/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agricultural Engineering/ Agriculture related field/ Biotechnology; Master's Degree (Full time) in Lifesciences/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agricultural Engineering/ Agriculture related field/ Biotechnology with MBA. Experience required: Minimum 5 years of experience in working in any sustainable agriculture project. Age limit: Maximum 40 years. Pay: upto 10 Lakhs per annum with 03% annual increment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 PROJECT MANAGER, 1 ASSISTANT PROJECT MANAGER.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Page 5) and send it to ADDITIONAL GENERAL MANAGER (HR & ADMN.), HIL (India) Limited, SCOPE Complex, Core-6, 2nd Floor, 7, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003, by speed post/courier/registered post/by hand, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - PROJECT MANAGER: maximum 55 years; ASSISTANT PROJECT MANAGER: maximum 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Upto Rs.16 Lakhs per annum with 03% annual increment for PROJECT MANAGER, upto 10 Lakhs per annum with 03% annual increment for ASSISTANT PROJECT MANAGER.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PhD or Master's Degree in Life Sciences/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agricultural Engineering/ Agriculture related field/ Biotechnology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with incomplete application. Candidates who have provided wrong information or submitted false documents.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Documents Verification/ Screening. Personal Interview. Screening of documents.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contractual engagement on purely temporary basis for a period upto 30.06.2028 or upto duration of project.
